sentences.text: Its upper jaw held roughly twenty-six pairs of slender teeth, while the lower jaw contained twenty-five.
The animal possessed long neck vertebrae and toes, but it lacked the fused front dorsal vertebrae called the notarium.
Dong Zhiming formally named this genus in 1982.
Workers at the Sanshilipu commune quarry uncovered the fossil in May 1978 following an explosion.
The blast that revealed the remains destroyed the right half of the specimen.
Scientists place Huanhepterus in the family Ctenochasmatidae and the subfamily Gnathosaurinae.
This creature inhabited the region of Qingyang, Gansu, China during the Early Cretaceous period.
Its existence spanned from the Valanginian to the Albian stages, occurring between 137.05 and 100.5 million years ago.
